package com.footballacademy.util;

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class InputSanitizer {
    private static final Pattern HTML_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("<[^>]*>");
    private static final Pattern SCRIPT_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("<script[^>]*>.*?</script>", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    private static final Pattern SQL_INJECTION_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("('(''|[^'])*')|(;)|(\b(ALTER|CREATE|DELETE|DROP|EXEC(UTE){0,1}|INSERT( +INTO){0,1}|MERGE|SELECT|UPDATE|UNION( +ALL){0,1})\b)", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    public static String sanitize(String input) {
        if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {
            return input;
        }
        String sanitized = SCRIPT_PATTERN.matcher(input).replaceAll("");
        sanitized = HTML_PATTERN.matcher(sanitized).replaceAll("");
        sanitized = sanitized.trim();
        return sanitized;
    }
    public static String sanitizeForSql(String input) {
        if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {
            return input;
        }
        if (SQL_INJECTION_PATTERN.matcher(input).find()) {
            throw new SecurityException("Potential SQL injection detected");
        }
        return input.replace("'", "''");
    }
    public static String sanitizeFilename(String filename) {
        if (filename == null || filename.isEmpty()) {
            return "file";
        }
        String sanitized = filename.replaceAll(".*[/\\\\]", "");
        sanitized = sanitized.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_");
        if (sanitized.length() > 255) {
            sanitized = sanitized.substring(0, 255);
        }
        return sanitized.isEmpty() ? "file" : sanitized;
    }
    public static String sanitizeEmail(String email) {
        if (email == null || email.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        return email.trim().toLowerCase();
    }
    public static String sanitizePhone(String phone) {
        if (phone == null || phone.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        return phone.replaceAll("[^0-9+]", "");
    }
    public static String sanitizeUrl(String url) {
        if (url == null || url.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        String sanitized = url.trim();
        if (!sanitized.matches("^(http|https)://.*")) {
            sanitized = "https://" + sanitized;
        }
        return sanitized;
    }
    public static String truncate(String input, int maxLength) {
        if (input == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (input.length() <= maxLength) {
            return input;
        }
        return input.substring(0, maxLength);
    }
    public static String removeControlCharacters(String input) {
        if (input == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return input.replaceAll("[\\x00-\\x1F\\x7F]", "");
    }
    public static boolean containsOnlySafeCharacters(String input, String allowedPattern) {
        if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }
        return input.matches(allowedPattern);
    }
    public static String sanitizeJson(String json) {
        if (json == null || json.isEmpty()) {
            return json;
        }
        String sanitized = removeControlCharacters(json);
        sanitized = sanitized.trim();
        return sanitized;
    }
    public static String escapeHtml(String input) {
        if (input == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return input.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;").replace("\"", "&quot;").replace("'", "&#39;");
    }
    public static String escapeJavaScript(String input) {
        if (input == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return input.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("'", "\\'").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\t", "\\t");
    }
}

package com.footballacademy.util;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;

public final
class MediaUrlUtil {
    private MediaUrlUtil() {
    }
    public static String baseUrl(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String scheme = request.getScheme();
        String host = request.getServerName();
        int port = request.getServerPort();
        String ctx = request.getContextPath();
        boolean defaultPort =("http" .equalsIgnoreCase(scheme) && port == 80) ||("https" .equalsIgnoreCase(scheme) && port == 443);
        return scheme + "://" + host +(defaultPort ? "" : ":" + port) + ctx;
    }
    public static String toAbsolute(HttpServletRequest request, String path) {
        if (path == null || path.isBlank()) return null;
        if (path.startsWith("http://") || path.startsWith("https://")) return path;
        String p = path.startsWith("/") ? path : "/" + path;
        return baseUrl(request) + p;
    }
}

package com.footballacademy.util;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public
class PageMapper {
    /**      * Convert a page of entities to a page of DTOs      */
    public static <E, D> Page<D> toDtoPage(Page<E> entityPage, Function<E, D> mapper) {
        List<D> dtoList = entityPage.getContent() .stream() .map(mapper) .collect(Collectors.toList());
        return new PageImpl<>(dtoList, entityPage.getPageable(), entityPage.getTotalElements());
    }
    /**      * Convert a list of entities to a page of DTOs      */
    public static <E, D> Page<D> toDtoPage(List<E> entities, Pageable pageable, Function<E, D> mapper) {
        int start =(int) pageable.getOffset();
        int end = Math.min((start + pageable.getPageSize()), entities.size());
        if (start >= entities.size()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), pageable, entities.size());
        } List<E> pageContent = entities.subList(start, end);
        List<D> dtoList = pageContent.stream() .map(mapper) .collect(Collectors.toList());
        return new PageImpl<>(dtoList, pageable, entities.size());
    }
    /**      * Convert a page of entities to a page of DTOs with custom total count      */
    public static <E, D> Page<D> toDtoPage(List<E> entities, Pageable pageable, long totalElements, Function<E, D> mapper) {
        int start =(int) pageable.getOffset();
        int end = Math.min((start + pageable.getPageSize()), entities.size());
        if (start >= entities.size()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), pageable, totalElements);
        } List<E> pageContent = entities.subList(start, end);
        List<D> dtoList = pageContent.stream() .map(mapper) .collect(Collectors.toList());
        return new PageImpl<>(dtoList, pageable, totalElements);
    }
    /**      * Create an empty page      */
    public static <T> Page<T> emptyPage(Pageable pageable) {
        return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), pageable, 0);
    }
    /**      * Create a single-item page      */
    public static <T> Page<T> singleItemPage(T item, Pageable pageable) {
        return new PageImpl<>(List.of(item), pageable, 1);
    }
}

package com.footballacademy.util;

import com.footballacademy.config.AppDefaults;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;

public
class PageRequestBuilder {
    public static Pageable createPageRequest(int page, int size) {
        return createPageRequest(page, size, null, null);
    }
    public static Pageable createPageRequest(int page, int size, String sortBy, String sortDirection) {
        // Validate and normalize page and size         page =
        Math.max(0, page);
        size = Math.min(Math.max(1, size), AppDefaults.MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
        // Handle sorting
        if (sortBy != null && !sortBy.isEmpty()) {
            Sort.Direction direction = parseSortDirection(sortDirection);
            return PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(direction, sortBy));
        } return PageRequest.of(page, size);
    }
    public static Pageable createPageRequest(int page, int size, Sort sort) {
        page = Math.max(0, page);
        size = Math.min(Math.max(1, size), AppDefaults.MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
        return PageRequest.of(page, size, sort);
    }
    public static Pageable createUnsortedPageRequest(int page, int size) {
        page = Math.max(0, page);
        size = Math.min(Math.max(1, size), AppDefaults.MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
        return PageRequest.of(page, size);
    }
    private static Sort.Direction parseSortDirection(String direction) {
        if (direction == null || direction.isEmpty()) {
            return Sort.Direction.ASC;
        }
        switch (direction.toLowerCase()) {
            case "desc" : case "descending" : return Sort.Direction.DESC;
            case "asc" : case "ascending" : default: return Sort.Direction.ASC;
        }
    }
    public static
    class PageMetadata {
        private final int currentPage;
        private final int pageSize;
        private final long totalElements;
        private final int totalPages;
        private final boolean isFirst;
        private final boolean isLast;
        private final boolean hasNext;
        private final boolean hasPrevious;
        public PageMetadata(Page<?> page) {
            this.currentPage = page.getNumber();
            this.pageSize = page.getSize();
            this.totalElements = page.getTotalElements();
            this.totalPages = page.getTotalPages();
            this.isFirst = page.isFirst();
            this.isLast = page.isLast();
            this.hasNext = page.hasNext();
            this.hasPrevious = page.hasPrevious();
        }
        // Getters
        public int getCurrentPage() {
            return currentPage;
        }
        public int getPageSize() {
            return pageSize;
        }
        public long getTotalElements() {
            return totalElements;
        }
        public int getTotalPages() {
            return totalPages;
        }
        public boolean isFirst() {
            return isFirst;
        }
        public boolean isLast() {
            return isLast;
        }
        public boolean hasNext() {
            return hasNext;
        }
        public boolean hasPrevious() {
            return hasPrevious;
        }
    }

===== FILE: D:\master_pfe\sports_management_project\src\main\java\com\footballacademy\util\PaginationUtil.java =====
package com.footballacademy.util;

import com.footballacademy.config.AppDefaults;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final
class PaginationUtil {
    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = AppDefaults.ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    private static final int MAX_PAGE_SIZE = AppDefaults.MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    private PaginationUtil() {
    }
    public static <T> PagedResult<T> paginate(List<T> all, int page, int size) {
        size = validateSize(size);
        page = validatePage(page);
        if (all == null) {
            return new PagedResult<>(Collections.emptyList(), page, size, 0, 0);
        } long totalItems = all.size();
        int totalPages = calculateTotalPages((int) totalItems, size);
        if (totalPages == 0) {
            return new PagedResult<>(Collections.emptyList(), page, size, 0, 0);
        }
        if (page >= totalPages) {
            page = totalPages - 1;
        } int from = page * size;
        int to = Math.min(from + size, all.size());
        List<T> slice =(from >= 0 && from < to) ? all.subList(from, to) : Collections.emptyList();
        return new PagedResult<>(slice, page, size, totalItems, totalPages);
    }
    public static <T> Page<T> createPage(List<T> items, Pageable pageable) {
        int start =(int) pageable.getOffset();
        int end = Math.min((start + pageable.getPageSize()), items.size());
        if (start >= items.size()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), pageable, items.size());
        } List<T> pageContent = items.subList(start, end);
        return new PageImpl<>(pageContent, pageable, items.size());
    }
    public static <T> Page<T> createPage(List<T> items, int page, int size) {
        size = validateSize(size);
        page = validatePage(page);
        int start = page * size;
        int end = Math.min(start + size, items.size());
        if (start >= items.size()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest.of(page, size), items.size());
        } List<T> pageContent = items.subList(start, end);
        return new PageImpl<>(pageContent, org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest.of(page, size), items.size());
    }
    public static int calculateTotalPages(int totalItems, int pageSize) {
        return(int) Math.ceil((double) totalItems / pageSize);
    }
    public static int validatePage(int page) {
        return Math.max(0, page);
    }
    public static int validateSize(int size) {
        return Math.min(Math.max(1, size), MAX_PAGE_SIZE);
    }
    public static int validateSize(int size, int maxSize) {
        return Math.min(Math.max(1, size), maxSize);
    }
    public static int getDefaultPageSize() {
        return DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
    }
    public static int getMaxPageSize() {
        return MAX_PAGE_SIZE;
    }
}


===== FILE: D:\master_pfe\sports_management_project\src\main\java\com\footballacademy\util\PasswordValidator.java =====
package com.footballacademy.util;

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public
class PasswordValidator {
    private static final int MIN_LENGTH = 8;
    private static final int MAX_LENGTH = 128;
    private static final Pattern UPPERCASE = Pattern.compile("[A-Z]");
    private static final Pattern LOWERCASE = Pattern.compile("[a-z]");
    private static final Pattern DIGIT = Pattern.compile("[0-9]");
    private static final Pattern SPECIAL = Pattern.compile("[!@#$%^&*()_+\\-=\\[\\]{};':\"\\\\|,.<>/?]");
    public static
    class ValidationResult {
        private final boolean valid;
        private final String message;
        public ValidationResult(boolean valid, String message) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.message = message;
        }
        public boolean isValid() {
            return valid;
        }
        public String getMessage() {
            return message;
        }
    }
    public static ValidationResult validate(String password) {
        if (password == null || password.isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Password cannot be empty");
        }
        if (password.length() < MIN_LENGTH) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Password must be at least %d characters long", MIN_LENGTH));
        }
        if (password.length() > MAX_LENGTH) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Password must not exceed %d characters", MAX_LENGTH));
        }
        if (!UPPERCASE.matcher(password) .find()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Password must contain at least one uppercase letter");
        }
        if (!LOWERCASE.matcher(password) .find()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Password must contain at least one lowercase letter");
        }
        if (!DIGIT.matcher(password) .find()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Password must contain at least one digit");
        }
        if (!SPECIAL.matcher(password) .find()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Password must contain at least one special character");
        }
        // Check for common weak passwords
        if (isCommonPassword(password)) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Password is too common. Please choose a stronger password");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Password is valid");
    }
    private static boolean isCommonPassword(String password) {
        String lowerPassword = password.toLowerCase();
        String[] commonPasswords = {
            "password", "123456", "12345678", "qwerty", "abc123", "monkey", "letmein", "dragon", "111111", "baseball", "iloveyou", "trustno1", "sunshine", "master", "hello", "freedom", "whatever", "qazwsx", "trustno1", "000000"
        };
        for (String common : commonPasswords) {
            if (lowerPassword.equals(common) || lowerPassword.contains(common)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        // Check for sequential patterns
        if (hasSequentialPattern(password)) {
            return true;
        }
        // Check for repeated characters
        if (hasRepeatedCharacters(password)) {
            return true;
        } return false;
    }
    private static boolean hasSequentialPattern(String password) {
        String lowerPassword = password.toLowerCase();
        for (int i = 0;
        i < lowerPassword.length() - 2;
        i++) {
            char c1 = lowerPassword.charAt(i);
            char c2 = lowerPassword.charAt(i + 1);
            char c3 = lowerPassword.charAt(i + 2);
            // Check for sequential letters or numbers
            if (c1 + 1 == c2 && c2 + 1 == c3) {
                return true;
            }
            if (c1 - 1 == c2 && c2 - 1 == c3) {
                return true;
            }
        } return false;
    }
    private static boolean hasRepeatedCharacters(String password) {
        for (int i = 0;
        i < password.length() - 2;
        i++) {
            char c = password.charAt(i);
            if (password.charAt(i + 1) == c && password.charAt(i + 2) == c) {
                return true;
            }
        } return false;
    }
    public static String generatePasswordRequirements() {
        return String.format("Password must be between %d and %d characters long, " + "contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, " + "one digit, and one special character", MIN_LENGTH, MAX_LENGTH);
    }
}

===== FILE: D:\master_pfe\sports_management_project\src\main\java\com\footballacademy\util\QueryOptimizer.java =====
package com.footballacademy.util;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public
class QueryOptimizer {
    /**      * Execute a query with pagination and avoid N+1 problem by using entity graphs      */
    public static <T, R> Page<R> executePaginatedQuery(JpaRepository<T, Long> repository, Pageable pageable, Function<List<T>, List<R>> mapper) {
        Page<T> entityPage = repository.findAll(pageable);
        List<R> dtoList = mapper.apply(entityPage.getContent());
        return new PageImpl<>(dtoList, pageable, entityPage.getTotalElements());
    }
    /**      * Batch process large datasets to avoid memory issues      */
    public static <T> void batchProcess(List<T> items, int batchSize, java.util.function.Consumer<List<T>> processor) {
        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0;
        i < items.size();
        i += batchSize) {
            int end = Math.min(i + batchSize, items.size());
            List<T> batch = items.subList(i, end);
            processor.accept(batch);
        }
    }
    /**      * Optimize query by selecting only needed fields      */
    public static <T, R> List<R> optimizeQuery(List<T> entities, Function<T, R> mapper) {
        if (entities == null || entities.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        } return entities.stream() .map(mapper) .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
    /**      * Lazy load relationships to avoid N+1 problem      */
    public static <T, R> List<R> lazyLoadOptimize(List<T> entities, Function<T, R> mapper) {
        if (entities == null || entities.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        } return entities.stream() .map(mapper) .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public
class ValidationUtils {
    private static final Pattern PHONE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^[+]?[0-9\\-\\s()]{7,20}$");
    private static final Pattern URL_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^(https?|ftp)://[^\\s/$.?#].[^\\s]*$");
    private static final Pattern DATE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$");
    private static final Pattern TIME_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^\\d{2}:\\d{2}(:\\d{2})?$");
    public static
    class ValidationResult {
        private final boolean valid;
        private final String message;
        public ValidationResult(boolean valid, String message) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.message = message;
        }
        public boolean isValid() {
            return valid;
        }
        public String getMessage() {
            return message;
        }
    }
    /**      * Validate phone number      */
    public static ValidationResult validatePhone(String phone) {
        if (phone == null || phone.isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Phone number cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!PHONE_PATTERN.matcher(phone) .matches()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Invalid phone number format");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Phone number is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate URL      */
    public static ValidationResult validateUrl(String url) {
        if (url == null || url.isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "URL cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!URL_PATTERN.matcher(url) .matches()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Invalid URL format");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "URL is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate date format (YYYY-MM-DD)      */
    public static ValidationResult validateDate(String date) {
        if (date == null || date.isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Date cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!DATE_PATTERN.matcher(date) .matches()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Invalid date format. Expected: YYYY-MM-DD");
        }
        try {
            java.time.LocalDate.parse(date);
            return new ValidationResult(true, "Date is valid");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Invalid date");
        }
    }
    /**      * Validate time format (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS)      */
    public static ValidationResult validateTime(String time) {
        if (time == null || time.isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Time cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!TIME_PATTERN.matcher(time) .matches()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Invalid time format. Expected: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Time is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate age      */
    public static ValidationResult validateAge(int age) {
        if (age < 0) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Age cannot be negative");
        }
        if (age > 150) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Age cannot exceed 150");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Age is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate positive number      */
    public static ValidationResult validatePositive(Number number) {
        if (number == null) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Number cannot be null");
        }
        if (number.doubleValue() <= 0) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Number must be positive");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Number is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate non-negative number      */
    public static ValidationResult validateNonNegative(Number number) {
        if (number == null) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Number cannot be null");
        }
        if (number.doubleValue() < 0) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Number cannot be negative");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Number is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate string length      */
    public static ValidationResult validateLength(String input, int minLength, int maxLength) {
        if (input == null) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Input cannot be null");
        }
        if (input.length() < minLength) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Input must be at least %d characters", minLength));
        }
        if (input.length() > maxLength) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Input cannot exceed %d characters", maxLength));
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Input length is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate numeric range      */
    public static ValidationResult validateRange(Number number, double min, double max) {
        if (number == null) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Number cannot be null");
        } double value = number.doubleValue();
        if (value < min) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Number must be at least %f", min));
        }
        if (value > max) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Number cannot exceed %f", max));
        } return new ValidationResult(true, "Number is within range");
    }
    /**      * Validate required field      */
    public static ValidationResult validateRequired(Object value, String fieldName) {
        if (value == null) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, fieldName + " is required");
        }
        if (value instanceof String &&((String) value) .trim() .isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, fieldName + " cannot be empty");
        } return new ValidationResult(true, fieldName + " is valid");
    }
    /**      * Validate enum value      */
    public static <T extends Enum<T>> ValidationResult validateEnum(String value, Class<T> enumClass) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, "Enum value cannot be empty");
        }
        try {
            Enum.valueOf(enumClass, value.toUpperCase());
            return new ValidationResult(true, "Enum value is valid");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, String.format("Invalid enum value. Valid values: %s", String.join(", ", getEnumNames(enumClass))));
        }
    }
    private static <T extends Enum<T>> String[] getEnumNames(Class<T> enumClass) {
        T[] constants = enumClass.getEnumConstants();
        String[] names = new String[constants.length];
        for (int i = 0;
        i < constants.length;
        i++) {
            names[i] = constants[i].name();
        } return names;
    }
}

package com.footballacademy.util;

import java.util.List;

public
class ViewPagination<T> {
    private final List<T> items;
    private final int currentPage;
    private final int totalPages;
    private final long totalItems;
    private final int pageSize;
    private final int fromItem;
    private final int toItem;
    private final boolean hasPrevious;
    private final boolean hasNext;
    private final String previousHref;
    private final String nextHref;
    private final List<PageLink> pageLinks;
    public ViewPagination(List<T> items, int currentPage, int totalPages, long totalItems, int pageSize, int fromItem, int toItem, boolean hasPrevious, boolean hasNext, String previousHref, String nextHref, List<PageLink> pageLinks) {
        this.items = items;
        this.currentPage = currentPage;
        this.totalPages = totalPages;
        this.totalItems = totalItems;
        this.pageSize = pageSize;
        this.fromItem = fromItem;
        this.toItem = toItem;
        this.hasPrevious = hasPrevious;
        this.hasNext = hasNext;
        this.previousHref = previousHref;
        this.nextHref = nextHref;
        this.pageLinks = pageLinks;
    }
    public List<T> getItems() {
        return items;
    }
    public int getCurrentPage() {
        return currentPage;
    }
    public int getTotalPages() {
        return totalPages;
    }
    public long getTotalItems() {
        return totalItems;
    }
    public int getPageSize() {
        return pageSize;
    }
    public int getFromItem() {
        return fromItem;
    }
    public int getToItem() {
        return toItem;
    }
    public boolean isHasPrevious() {
        return hasPrevious;
    }
    public boolean isHasNext() {
        return hasNext;
    }
    public String getPreviousHref() {
        return previousHref;
    }
    public String getNextHref() {
        return nextHref;
    }
    public List<PageLink> getPageLinks() {
        return pageLinks;
    }
    public static
    class PageLink {
        private final String label;
        private final String href;
        private final boolean active;
        public PageLink(String label, String href, boolean active) {
            this.label = label;
            this.href = href;
            this.active = active;
        }
        public String getLabel() {
            return label;
        }
        public String getHref() {
            return href;
        }
        public boolean isActive() {
            return active;
        }
    }
}

         state.messageSubs.set(key, sub);       }        function connectRealtime() {         if (!window.SockJS || !window.Stomp) {           setStatus('Realtime library unavailable', true);           return;         }          try {           const socket = new SockJS(wsPath);           const client = window.Stomp.over(socket);           client.debug = null;            const token = localStorage.getItem('JWT_TOKEN') || localStorage.getItem('access_token') || localStorage.getItem('accessToken');           const connectHeaders = token             ? { Authorization: token.startsWith('Bearer ') ? token : `Bearer ${token}` }             : {};            client.connect(connectHeaders, () => {             state.stompClient = client;             setStatus('Realtime connected');              if (state.conversationSub) {               state.conversationSub.unsubscribe();             }             state.conversationSub = client.subscribe(`/topic/conversations/${state.me.id}`, (frame) => {               if (!frame.body) return;               const summary = JSON.parse(frame.body);               upsertConversation(summary);               renderDirectory();             });              state.conversations.forEach((conv) => subscribeConversationMessages(conv.id));           }, (err) => {             setStatus('Realtime disconnected', true);             console.error(err);           });         } catch (err) {           setStatus('Realtime connection failed', true);           console.error(err);         }       }        async function openConversation(conversationId, fetchMessages = true) {         state.activeConversationId = Number(conversationId);         updatePanels();         renderDirectory();          if (!fetchMessages) {           renderMessages();           return;         }          ui.messagesList.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-sm text-slate-500">Loading messages...</div>';         try {           const messages = await api(`/chat/conversations/${conversationId}/messages`);           const list = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [];           state.messagesByConversation.set(Number(conversationId), list);           subscribeConversationMessages(conversationId);           renderMessages();            await api(`/chat/conversations/${conversationId}/read`, {             method: 'PUT',             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },             body: JSON.stringify({})           });            const conv = state.conversations.find((c) => Number(c.id) === Number(conversationId));           if (conv) conv.unreadCount = 0;           renderDirectory();         } catch (err) {           ui.messagesList.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 text-sm text-rose-700">${escapeHtml(err.message)}</div>`;         }       }        async function openContact(contactId, kind) {         const contact = state.contacts.find((c) => Number(c.id) === Number(contactId));         if (!contact) return;          try {           if ((kind || '').toUpperCase() === 'GROUP') {             if (!contact.conversationId) throw new Error('Group conversation is missing');             await openConversation(contact.conversationId, true);             return;           }            const res = await api('/chat/conversations/direct', {             method: 'POST',             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },             body: JSON.stringify({ otherUserId: contact.id })           });            const conversationId = Number(res.conversationId);           if (!conversationId) throw new Error('Failed to open direct conversation');            await loadConversations();           state.conversations.forEach((conv) => subscribeConversationMessages(conv.id));           renderDirectory();           await openConversation(conversationId, true);         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Failed to open contact', true);         }       }        function clientTempId() {         if (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID) {           return `tmp_${window.crypto.randomUUID()}`;         }         return `tmp_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)}`;       }        async function sendMessage() {         const text = ui.messageInput.value.trim();         if (!text || !state.activeConversationId) return;          const conversation = state.conversations.find((c) => Number(c.id) === Number(state.activeConversationId));         if (!conversation) return;          const tempId = clientTempId();         const optimistic = {           id: null,           conversationId: state.activeConversationId,           senderId: state.me.id,           receiverId: null,           content: text,           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),           read: true,           clientTempId: tempId,           _optimistic: true         };          const list = state.messagesByConversation.get(state.activeConversationId) || [];         list.push(optimistic);         state.messagesByConversation.set(state.activeConversationId, list);          conversation.lastMessage = text;         conversation.lastMessageAt = optimistic.timestamp;         conversation.updatedAt = optimistic.timestamp;         sortConversations();          ui.messageInput.value = '';         renderDirectory();         renderMessages();          let receiverId = null;         if (Array.isArray(conversation.participants) && conversation.participants.length === 2) {           const other = conversation.participants.find((p) => Number(p.id) !== Number(state.me.id));           receiverId = other ? Number(other.id) : null;         }          try {           await api(`/chat/conversations/${state.activeConversationId}/messages`, {             method: 'POST',             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },             body: JSON.stringify({               senderId: Number(state.me.id),               receiverId,               content: text,               clientTempId: tempId             })           });         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Message send failed', true);         }       }        function bindEvents() {         ui.tabConversations.addEventListener('click', () => {           state.activeTab = 'conversations';           state.search = '';           ui.directorySearch.value = '';           ui.directorySearch.placeholder = 'Search conversations';           renderDirectory();         });          ui.tabContacts.addEventListener('click', () => {           state.activeTab = 'contacts';           state.search = '';           ui.directorySearch.value = '';           ui.directorySearch.placeholder = 'Search contacts';           state.contacts = state.defaultContacts;           renderDirectory();         });          ui.directorySearch.addEventListener('input', async (event) => {           state.search = event.target.value || '';            if (state.activeTab === 'conversations') {             renderDirectory();             return;           }            if (state.searchTimer) clearTimeout(state.searchTimer);           state.searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {             try {               if (state.search.trim().length >= 2) {                 await loadContacts(state.search);               } else {                 state.contacts = state.defaultContacts;               }               renderDirectory();             } catch (err) {               setStatus(err.message || 'Search failed', true);             }           }, 250);         });          ui.directoryList.addEventListener('click', (event) => {           const convButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-conv]');           if (convButton) {             openConversation(Number(convButton.dataset.openConv), true);             return;           }            const contactButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-contact]');           if (contactButton) {             openContact(Number(contactButton.dataset.openContact), contactButton.dataset.kind || 'USER');           }         });          ui.composerForm.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {           event.preventDefault();           await sendMessage();         });          ui.mobileBackBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {           state.activeConversationId = null;           renderMessages();           updatePanels();           renderDirectory();         });          window.addEventListener('resize', updatePanels);       }        async function bootstrap() {         bindEvents();         updatePanels();          try {           await loadMe();           await Promise.all([loadContacts(''), loadConversations()]);            updateRolePanel();           ui.directorySearch.placeholder = 'Search conversations';           renderDirectory();           renderMessages();            connectRealtime();           state.conversations.forEach((conv) => subscribeConversationMessages(conv.id));            if (state.conversations.length > 0 && !isMobile()) {             await openConversation(state.conversations[0].id, true);           }         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Failed to load chat', true);           ui.directoryList.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 text-sm text-rose-700">${escapeHtml(err.message || 'Unable to initialize chat.')}</div>`;           ui.messagesList.innerHTML = '<div class="rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 text-sm text-rose-700">Chat is unavailable right now.</div>';         }       }        bootstrap();     })();   </script> </body> </html>

      }        function displayConversationName(conv) {         const participants = Array.isArray(conv.participants) ? conv.participants : [];         if (participants.length === 2 && state.me) {           const other = participants.find((p) => Number(p.id) !== Number(state.me.id));       }        function formatRelativeTime(dateInput) {         if (!dateInput) return '';         const dt = new Date(dateInput);         if (Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())) return '';          const diffMs = Date.now() - dt.getTime();         const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);         const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);         const diffDay = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);          if (diffMin < 1) return 'Just now';         if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin} min ago`;         if (diffHour < 24) return `${diffHour}h ago`;         if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay}d ago`;         return `${String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(dt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;       }        function formatPreciseTime(dateInput) {         if (!dateInput) return '--';         const dt = new Date(dateInput);         if (Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())) return '--';         return `${String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(dt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')} Ã‚Â· ${String(dt.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(dt.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;         }).join('');       }        function upsertConversation(update) {         const index = state.conversations.findIndex((conv) => Number(conv.id) === Number(update.id));         if (index >= 0) {           state.conversations[index] = { ...state.conversations[index], ...update };         } else {           state.conversations.unshift(update);         }         sortConversations();         subscribeConversationMessages(update.id);         renderOverview();       }        function upsertMessage(conversationId, message) {         const key = Number(conversationId);         const current = state.messagesByConversation.get(key) || [];          const byId = message.id != null           ? current.findIndex((item) => item.id != null && Number(item.id) === Number(message.id))           : -1;          const byTemp = byId < 0 && message.clientTempId           ? current.findIndex((item) => item.clientTempId && item.clientTempId === message.clientTempId)           : -1;          if (byId >= 0) {           current[byId] = { ...current[byId], ...message, _optimistic: false };         } else if (byTemp >= 0) {           current[byTemp] = { ...current[byTemp], ...message, _optimistic: false };         } else {           current.push({ ...message, _optimistic: false });         }          current.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime());         state.messagesByConversation.set(key, current);       }        async function loadMe() {         const me = await fetchJson(profileLitePath);         state.me = me;         state.role = (me.role || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();       }        async function loadConversations() {         const list = await api('/chat/conversations');         state.conversations = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];         sortConversations();         renderOverview();       }        async function loadContacts(query = '') {         const hasQuery = query.trim().length >= 2;         const suffix = hasQuery ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}` : '';         const list = await api(`/chat/contacts${suffix}`);         const contacts = Array.isArray(list) ? list.filter((contact) => Number(contact.id) !== Number(state.me.id)) : [];          if (hasQuery) {           state.contacts = contacts;           renderOverview();           return;         }          state.defaultContacts = contacts;         state.contacts = contacts;         if (state.role === 'ADMIN') {           state.isAdminFullAccess = contacts.some((contact) => (contact.kind || '').toUpperCase() === 'GROUP')             || contacts.some((contact) => (contact.role || '').toUpperCase() !== 'ADMIN');         }         renderOverview();       }        function subscribeConversationMessages(conversationId) {         if (!state.stompClient) return;         const key = Number(conversationId);         if (state.messageSubs.has(key)) return;          const subscription = state.stompClient.subscribe(`/topic/messages/${key}`, (frame) => {           if (!frame.body) return;           const message = JSON.parse(frame.body);           upsertMessage(key, message);            const conversation = state.conversations.find((conv) => Number(conv.id) === key);           if (conversation) {             conversation.lastMessage = message.content || '';             conversation.lastMessageAt = message.timestamp;             conversation.updatedAt = message.timestamp;              if (Number(state.activeConversationId) !== key && Number(message.senderId) !== Number(state.me.id)) {               conversation.unreadCount = Number(conversation.unreadCount || 0) + 1;             }           }            sortConversations();           renderOverview();           renderDirectory();           if (Number(state.activeConversationId) === key) {             renderMessages();           }         });          state.messageSubs.set(key, subscription);       }        function startPollingFallback() {         if (state.pollTimer) return;         setStatus('Realtime libraries unavailable Ã‚Â· syncing every 10 seconds', 'fallback');         state.pollTimer = window.setInterval(async () => {           try {             await loadConversations();             if (state.activeConversationId) {               const messages = await api(`/chat/conversations/${state.activeConversationId}/messages`);               state.messagesByConversation.set(Number(state.activeConversationId), Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : []);               renderMessages();             }             renderDirectory();             markRefreshed();           } catch (_) {}         }, 10000);       }        function connectRealtime() {         if (!window.SockJS || !window.Stomp) {           startPollingFallback();           return;         }          try {           const socket = new SockJS(wsPath);           const client = window.Stomp.over(socket);           client.debug = null;            const token = localStorage.getItem('JWT_TOKEN') || localStorage.getItem('access_token') || localStorage.getItem('accessToken');           const connectHeaders = token             ? { Authorization: token.startsWith('Bearer ') ? token : `Bearer ${token}` }             : {};            client.connect(connectHeaders, () => {             state.stompClient = client;             setStatus('Realtime connected', 'ok');              if (state.pollTimer) {               window.clearInterval(state.pollTimer);               state.pollTimer = null;             }              if (state.conversationSub) {               state.conversationSub.unsubscribe();             }              state.conversationSub = client.subscribe(`/topic/conversations/${state.me.id}`, (frame) => {               if (!frame.body) return;               const summary = JSON.parse(frame.body);               upsertConversation(summary);               renderDirectory();             });              state.conversations.forEach((conversation) => subscribeConversationMessages(conversation.id));             markRefreshed();           }, () => {             startPollingFallback();           });         } catch (_) {           startPollingFallback();         }       }        async function openConversation(conversationId, fetchMessages = true) {         state.activeConversationId = Number(conversationId);         updatePanels();         renderOverview();         renderDirectory();          if (!fetchMessages) {           renderMessages();           return;         }          ui.messagesList.innerHTML = `           <div class="mx-auto mt-10 max-w-md rounded-[1.6rem] bg-white p-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-slate-200">             Loading messages...           </div>`;          try {           const messages = await api(`/chat/conversations/${conversationId}/messages`);           state.messagesByConversation.set(Number(conversationId), Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : []);           subscribeConversationMessages(conversationId);           renderMessages();            await api(`/chat/conversations/${conversationId}/read`, {             method: 'PUT',             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },             body: JSON.stringify({})           });            const conversation = state.conversations.find((conv) => Number(conv.id) === Number(conversationId));           if (conversation) conversation.unreadCount = 0;           renderOverview();           renderDirectory();           markRefreshed();         } catch (err) {           ui.messagesList.innerHTML = `             <div class="mx-auto mt-10 max-w-md rounded-[1.6rem] border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-6 text-center text-sm text-rose-700 shadow-sm">               ${escapeHtml(err.message || 'Unable to open conversation.')}             </div>`;         }       }        async function openContact(contactId, kind) {         const contact = state.contacts.find((item) => Number(item.id) === Number(contactId));         if (!contact) return;          try {           if ((kind || '').toUpperCase() === 'GROUP') {             if (!contact.conversationId) throw new Error('Group conversation is missing');             await openConversation(contact.conversationId, true);             return;           }            const response = await api('/chat/conversations/direct', {             method: 'POST',             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },             body: JSON.stringify({ otherUserId: contact.id })           });            const conversationId = Number(response.conversationId);           if (!conversationId) throw new Error('Failed to open direct conversation');            await loadConversations();           state.conversations.forEach((conversation) => subscribeConversationMessages(conversation.id));           renderDirectory();           await openConversation(conversationId, true);         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Failed to open contact', 'error');         }       }        function clientTempId() {         if (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID) {           return `tmp_${window.crypto.randomUUID()}`;         }         return `tmp_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)}`;       }        async function sendMessage() {         const text = ui.messageInput.value.trim();         if (!text || !state.activeConversationId) return;          const conversation = state.conversations.find((item) => Number(item.id) === Number(state.activeConversationId));         if (!conversation) return;          const tempId = clientTempId();         const optimistic = {           id: null,           conversationId: state.activeConversationId,           senderId: state.me.id,           receiverId: null,           content: text,           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),           read: true,           clientTempId: tempId,           _optimistic: true         };          const current = state.messagesByConversation.get(Number(state.activeConversationId)) || [];         current.push(optimistic);         state.messagesByConversation.set(Number(state.activeConversationId), current);          conversation.lastMessage = text;         conversation.lastMessageAt = optimistic.timestamp;         conversation.updatedAt = optimistic.timestamp;         sortConversations();          ui.messageInput.value = '';         autoResizeComposer();         renderOverview();         renderDirectory();         renderMessages();          let receiverId = null;         if (Array.isArray(conversation.participants) && conversation.participants.length === 2) {           const other = conversation.participants.find((participant) => Number(participant.id) !== Number(state.me.id));           receiverId = other ? Number(other.id) : null;         }          try {           await api(`/chat/conversations/${state.activeConversationId}/messages`, {             method: 'POST',             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },             body: JSON.stringify({               senderId: Number(state.me.id),               receiverId,               content: text,               clientTempId: tempId             })           });           markRefreshed();         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Message send failed', 'error');         }       }        function autoResizeComposer() {         ui.messageInput.style.height = 'auto';         ui.messageInput.style.height = `${Math.min(ui.messageInput.scrollHeight, 160)}px`;       }        async function refreshWorkspace() {         try {           await Promise.all([loadContacts(''), loadConversations()]);           renderDirectory();           renderOverview();           if (state.activeConversationId) {             await openConversation(state.activeConversationId, true);           } else {             renderMessages();           }           markRefreshed();         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Refresh failed', 'error');         }       }        function switchToContacts() {         state.activeTab = 'contacts';         state.search = '';         ui.directorySearch.value = '';         ui.directorySearch.placeholder = 'Search contacts';         state.contacts = state.defaultContacts;         renderDirectory();         updatePanels();       }        function switchToConversations() {         state.activeTab = 'conversations';         state.search = '';         ui.directorySearch.value = '';         ui.directorySearch.placeholder = 'Search conversations';         renderDirectory();         updatePanels();       }        function bindEvents() {         ui.tabConversations.addEventListener('click', switchToConversations);         ui.tabContacts.addEventListener('click', switchToContacts);         ui.heroBrowseContactsBtn.addEventListener('click', switchToContacts);         ui.heroBrowseConversationsBtn.addEventListener('click', switchToConversations);         ui.heroRefreshBtn.addEventListener('click', refreshWorkspace);         ui.sidebarRefreshBtn.addEventListener('click', refreshWorkspace);         ui.headerContactsBtn.addEventListener('click', switchToContacts);         ui.headerRefreshBtn.addEventListener('click', refreshWorkspace);         ui.contextOpenContactsBtn.addEventListener('click', switchToContacts);         ui.contextOpenConversationsBtn.addEventListener('click', switchToConversations);         ui.contextReloadBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {           if (state.activeConversationId) {             await openConversation(state.activeConversationId, true);           }         });          ui.directorySearch.addEventListener('input', async (event) => {           state.search = event.target.value || '';            if (state.activeTab === 'conversations') {             renderDirectory();             return;           }            if (state.searchTimer) clearTimeout(state.searchTimer);           state.searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {             try {               if (state.search.trim().length >= 2) {                 await loadContacts(state.search);               } else {                 state.contacts = state.defaultContacts;               }               renderDirectory();             } catch (err) {               setStatus(err.message || 'Search failed', 'error');             }           }, 250);         });          ui.directoryList.addEventListener('click', (event) => {           const conversationButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-conv]');           if (conversationButton) {             openConversation(Number(conversationButton.dataset.openConv), true);             return;           }            const contactButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-contact]');           if (contactButton) {             openContact(Number(contactButton.dataset.openContact), contactButton.dataset.kind || 'USER');           }         });          ui.composerForm.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {           event.preventDefault();           await sendMessage();         });          ui.messageInput.addEventListener('input', autoResizeComposer);         ui.messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', async (event) => {           if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) {             event.preventDefault();             await sendMessage();           }         });          ui.mobileBackBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {           state.activeConversationId = null;           renderOverview();           renderMessages();           updatePanels();           renderDirectory();         });          window.addEventListener('resize', updatePanels);       }        async function bootstrap() {         bindEvents();         updatePanels();         autoResizeComposer();          try {           await loadMe();           await Promise.all([loadContacts(''), loadConversations()]);            updateRolePanel();           switchToConversations();           renderOverview();           renderMessages();            connectRealtime();           state.conversations.forEach((conversation) => subscribeConversationMessages(conversation.id));            if (state.conversations.length > 0 && !isMobile()) {             await openConversation(state.conversations[0].id, true);           } else {             markRefreshed();           }         } catch (err) {           setStatus(err.message || 'Failed to load chat', 'error');           ui.directoryList.innerHTML = `             <div class="rounded-[1.6rem] border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-5 text-sm text-rose-700 shadow-sm">               ${escapeHtml(err.message || 'Unable to initialize chat.')}             </div>`;           ui.messagesList.innerHTML = `             <div class="mx-auto mt-10 max-w-md rounded-[1.6rem] border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-6 text-center text-sm text-rose-700 shadow-sm">               Chat is unavailable right now.             </div>`;         }       }        bootstrap();     })();   </script> </body> </html>

You can improve the answer from the panel on the right at any time.           </div>         `;         return;       }        nodes.chatThread.innerHTML = state.messages.map(message => {         if (message.role === 'user') {           return `             <div class="ml-auto max-w-2xl rounded-[1.6rem] px-5 py-4 text-sm leading-7 shadow-sm chat-bubble-user">               <p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-50/80">Admin</p>               <p class="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap">${escapeHtml(message.content)}</p>             </div>           `;         }          const confidenceTone = confidenceClass(message.meta?.confidence);         const suggestions = message.meta?.suggestions || [];         return `           <div class="max-w-3xl rounded-[1.6rem] px-5 py-5 shadow-sm chat-bubble-bot">             <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">               <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-700">                 <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">smart_toy</span>                 Chatbot               </span>               <span class="rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] ${confidenceTone}">                 ${escapeHtml(message.meta?.confidence || 'LOW')} confidence               </span>               ${message.meta?.scope ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-600">${escapeHtml(message.meta.scope)}</span>` : ''}             </div>             <div class="mt-4 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">${escapeHtml(message.content)}</div>             <details class="mt-4 rounded-[1.3rem] bg-slate-50 p-4 text-sm text-slate-600">               <summary class="cursor-pointer list-none font-semibold text-slate-900">Answer details</summary>               <div class="mt-3 grid gap-3">                 <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4">                   <span><span class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Matched question:</span> ${escapeHtml(message.meta?.matchedQuestion || 'None')}</span>                   <span><span class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Score:</span> ${Number(message.meta?.score || 0)}</span>                   <span><span class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Source:</span> ${escapeHtml(humanize(message.meta?.sourceType || 'manual'))}</span>                 </div>                 ${suggestions.length ? `                   <div>                     <p class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Similar saved questions</p>                     <div class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">                       ${suggestions.map(item => `<button type="button" class="suggestion-chip rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700" data-suggestion-question="${escapeHtmlAttr(item.question)}">${escapeHtml(item.question)}</button>`).join('')}                     </div>                   </div>                 ` : ''}               </div>             </details>             <div class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">               <button type="button" class="message-action rounded-full border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50" data-action="ok">Looks good</button>               <button type="button" class="message-action rounded-full border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50" data-action="replace">Improve answer</button>               <button type="button" class="message-action rounded-full border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50" data-action="new">Save as new answer</button>             </div>           </div>         `;       }).join('');        nodes.chatThread.querySelectorAll('.message-action').forEach(button => {         button.addEventListener('click', () => {           const action = button.dataset.action;           if (action === 'ok') {             showAlert('Answer reviewed.', 'success');             return;           }           focusTeaching(action === 'replace' ? 'replace' : 'new');         });       });        nodes.chatThread.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-chip').forEach(button => {         button.addEventListener('click', () => {           nodes.questionInput.value = button.dataset.suggestionQuestion || '';         });       });        nodes.chatThread.scrollTop = nodes.chatThread.scrollHeight;     }      function renderStatus() {       if (!state.lastAnswer) {         nodes.answerStatusCard.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm text-slate-500">Ask a question to review the reply and decide whether it should be updated.</p>';         return;       }        nodes.answerStatusCard.innerHTML = `         <div class="grid gap-3">           <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">             <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Matched question</span>             <span class="rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] ${confidenceClass(state.lastAnswer.confidence)}">${escapeHtml(state.lastAnswer.confidence || 'LOW')}</span>           </div>           <p class="text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">${escapeHtml(state.lastAnswer.matchedQuestion || 'No match found yet')}</p>           <div class="grid gap-2 text-sm text-slate-600">             <p><span class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Score:</span> ${Number(state.lastAnswer.score || 0)}</p>             <p><span class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Source type:</span> ${escapeHtml(humanize(state.lastAnswer.sourceType || 'manual'))}</p>             <p><span class="font-semibold text-slate-900">Scope:</span> ${escapeHtml(humanize(state.lastAnswer.scope || state.bootstrap?.defaultScope || 'academy'))}</p>           </div>         </div>       `;     }      function renderRecentEntries() {       const entries = state.bootstrap?.recentEntries || [];       nodes.recentEntries.innerHTML = entries.length         ? entries.map(entry => `             <article class="rounded-[1.35rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-4">               <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">                 <div>                   <p class="font-semibold text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(entry.question || 'Question')}</p>                   <p class="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">${escapeHtml(entry.answerPreview || '')}</p>                 </div>                 <span class="rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-600">${escapeHtml(entry.scope || 'ACADEMY')}</span>               </div>               <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">                 <span>${escapeHtml(humanize(entry.sourceType || 'manual'))}</span>                 ${entry.tags ? `<span>- ${escapeHtml(entry.tags)}</span>` : ''}               </div>             </article>           `).join('')         : '<div class="rounded-[1.35rem] border border-dashed border-slate-200 px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">No chatbot knowledge entries yet.</div>';     }      async function askChatbot() {       const question = nodes.questionInput.value.trim();       if (!question) {         showAlert('Please type a question first.', 'error');         return;       }        state.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: question });       renderChat();        try {         const result = await api('/api/chatbot/admin/ask', {           method: 'POST',           body: JSON.stringify({             question,             academyId: state.bootstrap?.academyId,             sportId: state.bootstrap?.sportId           })         });          state.lastAnswer = result;         state.messages.push({           role: 'assistant',           content: result.answer || "Sorry, I don't have an answer for that yet.",           meta: result         });         renderChat();         renderStatus();         prefillTeachFormFromAnswer('replace');       } catch (error) {         showAlert(error.message, 'error');       }     }      function prefillTeachFormFromAnswer(mode) {       state.teachingMode = mode;       nodes.teachModeBadge.textContent = mode === 'replace' ? 'Replace answer' : 'New answer';       nodes.replaceExistingCheckbox.checked = mode === 'replace' && !!state.lastAnswer?.id;       nodes.teachQuestionInput.value = state.lastAnswer?.question || nodes.questionInput.value.trim();       nodes.teachAnswerInput.value = state.lastAnswer?.answer && state.lastAnswer.answer !== "Sorry, I don't have an answer for that yet."         ? state.lastAnswer.answer         : '';       nodes.teachTagsInput.value = state.lastAnswer?.tags || '';       nodes.teachScopeSelect.value = state.lastAnswer?.scope || state.bootstrap?.defaultScope || 'ACADEMY';     }      function focusTeaching(mode) {       prefillTeachFormFromAnswer(mode);       nodes.teachQuestionInput.focus();       nodes.teachQuestionInput.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });     }      function clearTeachingForm() {       state.teachingMode = 'new';       nodes.teachModeBadge.textContent = 'New answer';       nodes.teachQuestionInput.value = '';       nodes.teachAnswerInput.value = '';       nodes.teachTagsInput.value = '';       nodes.replaceExistingCheckbox.checked = false;       nodes.teachScopeSelect.value = state.bootstrap?.defaultScope || 'ACADEMY';     }      async function saveTeachingRule() {       const question = nodes.teachQuestionInput.value.trim();       const answer = nodes.teachAnswerInput.value.trim();       if (!question) {         showAlert('Please add the question you want the chatbot to answer.', 'error');         return;       }       if (!answer) {         showAlert('Please add the answer you want to save.', 'error');         return;       }        try {         const payload = {           question,           answer,           tags: nodes.teachTagsInput.value.trim(),           scope: nodes.teachScopeSelect.value,           academyId: state.bootstrap?.academyId,           sportId: state.bootstrap?.sportId         };         if (nodes.replaceExistingCheckbox.checked && state.lastAnswer?.id) {           payload.replaceEntryId = state.lastAnswer.id;         }          const result = await api('/api/chatbot/admin/teach', {           method: 'POST',           body: JSON.stringify(payload)         });          state.bootstrap.recentEntries = result.recentEntries || state.bootstrap.recentEntries || [];         showAlert(result.message || 'Answer saved successfully.', 'success');         clearTeachingForm();         renderRecentEntries();       } catch (error) {         showAlert(error.message, 'error');       }     }      function resetConversation() {       state.messages = [];       state.lastAnswer = null;       nodes.questionInput.value = '';       clearTeachingForm();       renderChat();       renderStatus();     }      function showAlert(message, tone) {       if (!message) return;       nodes.pageAlert.textContent = message;       nodes.pageAlert.className = 'mt-5 rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium';       if (tone === 'success') {         nodes.pageAlert.classList.add('border-emerald-200', 'bg-emerald-50', 'text-emerald-800');       } else {         nodes.pageAlert.classList.add('border-rose-200', 'bg-rose-50', 'text-rose-700');       }       nodes.pageAlert.classList.remove('hidden');     }      function confidenceClass(confidence) {       switch ((confidence || '').toUpperCase()) {         case 'HIGH': return 'confidence-high';         case 'MEDIUM': return 'confidence-medium';         default: return 'confidence-low';       }     }      function humanize(value) {       return String(value || '')         .toLowerCase()         .split('_')         .filter(Boolean)         .map(part => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))         .join(' ');     }      function escapeHtml(value) {       return String(value ?? '')         .replaceAll('&', '&')         .replaceAll('<', '<')         .replaceAll('>', '>')         .replaceAll('"', '"')         .replaceAll("'", ''');     }      function escapeHtmlAttr(value) {       return escapeHtml(value).replaceAll('`', '`');     }   </script> </body> </html>

# Thymeleaf Shared Components - Sidebar & Navbar  This document explains how to use the reusable Thymeleaf components for sidebar and navbar across all pages.  ## File Structure  ``` pages/modules/ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒâ€¦Ã¢â‚¬Å“ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ components/ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡   ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒâ€¦Ã¢â‚¬Å“ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ sidebar.html      # Reusable sidebar fragment ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡   ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ navbar.html       # Reusable navbar fragment ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒâ€¦Ã¢â‚¬Å“ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ layouts/ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡   ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ base.html         # Base layout template with sidebar & navbar ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ admin/     ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚ÂÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ dashboard-example.html  # Example page using the layout ```  ## Components Overview  ### 1. **sidebar.html** - Reusable Navigation Sidebar - Fixed left-side navigation (w-64 width) - Dynamic active menu highlighting based on `activeMenu` attribute - Links to all main sections - Footer info box  **Fragment Name:** `sidebar`  **Variables Used:** - `activeMenu` - Current active menu item (e.g., "users", "players", "admin")  ### 2. **navbar.html** - Reusable Top Navigation Bar - Sticky top header (ml-64 to account for sidebar) - Search bar - Notifications dropdown - Settings dropdown - User profile dropdown with logout  **Fragment Name:** `navbar`  **Variables Used:** - `pageTitle` - Title to display in navbar - `user.nom` - User's name (for profile button) - `user.email` - User's email (for profile dropdown) - `unreadCount` - Number of unread notifications  ### 3. **base.html** - Base Layout Template - Combines sidebar and navbar - Tailwind CSS configuration - Material Icons - Provides placeholder blocks for child pages - Script for dropdown menu handling  ## Usage Methods  ### Method 1: Using Thymeleaf Layout Dialect (Recommended)  This is the cleanest approach and requires the `thymeleaf-layout-dialect` dependency.  Add to your `pom.xml`: ```xml <dependency>     <groupId>nz.net.ultraq.thymeleaf</groupId>     <artifactId>thymeleaf-layout-dialect</artifactId>     <version>3.2.1</version> </dependency> ```  **Example Page:** ```html <!DOCTYPE html> <html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org"        xmlns:layout="http://www.ultraq.net.nz/thymeleaf/layout"        layout:decorate="pages/modules/layouts/base">  <head>   <title layout:title-pattern="$TITLE_INDEX">My Page | Football Academy</title> </head>  <body>   <th:block layout:fragment="pageContent">     <!-- Your page content goes here -->     <h1>Welcome to My Page</h1>   </th:block>    <th:block layout:fragment="pageScripts">     <!-- Page-specific scripts -->     <script>       console.log('Page loaded');     </script>   </th:block> </body> </html> ```  ### Method 2: Using Direct Fragment Replacement  If you can't use the layout dialect, use `th:replace`:  ```html <!DOCTYPE html> <html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org"> <head>   <!-- Your head content --> </head> <body>   <!-- Include sidebar -->   <th:block th:replace="pages/modules/components/sidebar :: sidebar" />      <!-- Include navbar -->   <th:block th:replace="pages/modules/components/navbar :: navbar" />      <!-- Your page content -->   <main class="ml-64 p-8">     <!-- Content here -->   </main> </body> </html> ```  ## Passing Variables to Components  ### From Controller:  ```java @GetMapping("/users") public String users(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserPrincipal p, Model m) {     m.addAttribute("activeMenu", "users");     m.addAttribute("pageTitle", "Users Management");     m.addAttribute("user", p.getUser());     m.addAttribute("unreadCount", notificationService.countUnreadNotifications(p.getUser().getId()));     return "pages/modules/data-management/users/list"; } ```  ### In Your Template:  ```html <!-- The navbar will automatically use these variables --> <th:block layout:fragment="pageContent">   <!-- Your content here --> </th:block> ```  ## Dynamic Active Menu Highlighting  The sidebar uses `th:classappend` to highlight the active menu item:  ```html <a th:href="@{/admin/view/users}"     th:classappend="${activeMenu == 'users' ? 'bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container font-bold' : ''}">   <span class="material-symbols-outlined">group</span> Users </a> ```  **Pass the activeMenu from your controller:** ```java m.addAttribute("activeMenu", "users"); ```  ## Complete Minimal Example  **Create a new file:** `pages/modules/admin/dashboard.html`  ```html <!DOCTYPE html> <html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org"        xmlns:layout="http://www.ultraq.net.nz/thymeleaf/layout"        layout:decorate="pages/modules/layouts/base">  <head>   <title layout:title-pattern="$TITLE_INDEX">Dashboard</title> </head>  <body>   <th:block layout:fragment="pageContent">     <div class="mb-8">       <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold" th:text="${pageTitle ?: 'Dashboard'}"></h2>       <p class="text-gray-600 mt-2">Welcome to the Football Academy Management System</p>     </div>          <!-- Your dashboard content here -->     <section class="bg-white rounded-lg p-6 shadow">       <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Quick Stats</h3>       <!-- Stats cards, tables, charts, etc. -->     </section>   </th:block> </body> </html> ```  **Update your controller:** ```java @GetMapping("/admin/dashboard") public String dashboard(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserPrincipal p, Model m) {     m.addAttribute("activeMenu", "admin");     m.addAttribute("pageTitle", "Dashboard");     m.addAttribute("user", p.getUser());     return "pages/modules/admin/dashboard"; } ```  ## Customization  ### Change Sidebar Colors Edit `pages/modules/components/sidebar.html`: - Modify the primary color classes (currently using `bg-primary-container`) - Change the icon (currently `sports_soccer`) - Update the title and description  ### Change Navbar Colors Edit `pages/modules/components/navbar.html`: - Modify the text colors - Change dropdown positions - Customize the search bar  ### Add New Menu Items Edit `pages/modules/components/sidebar.html` and add: ```html <a th:href="@{/admin/view/new-page}"     class="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out rounded-md text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-emerald-700"     th:classappend="${activeMenu == 'new-page' ? 'bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container font-bold' : ''}">   <span class="material-symbols-outlined">icon_name</span> New Page </a> ```  ## Key CSS Classes Used  - `w-64` - Sidebar width (256px) - `ml-64` - Left margin for main content (to account for sidebar) - `sticky top-0` - Navbar sticks to top on scroll - `fixed left-0 top-0` - Sidebar fixed position - `z-50` - Sidebar/navbar z-index - Tailwind color system: `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary`, etc.  ## Troubleshooting  1. **Sidebar not showing**: Check that the sidebar width class `w-64` is applied 2. **Content overlapping sidebar**: Ensure main content has `ml-64` class 3. **Dropdown not working**: Check that JavaScript for dropdowns is loaded 4. **Styles not applying**: Verify Tailwind CSS is included in the `<head>` 5. **Links not working**: Check that `th:href` URLs are correct and match your route mappings  ## Integration Checklist  - [ ] Add `thymeleaf-layout-dialect` to `pom.xml` - [ ] Copy/create `sidebar.html` in `pages/modules/components/` - [ ] Copy/create `navbar.html` in `pages/modules/components/` - [ ] Copy/create `base.html` in `pages/modules/layouts/` - [ ] Update your controller to pass `activeMenu`, `pageTitle`, `user`, `unreadCount` - [ ] Use `layout:decorate="pages/modules/layouts/base"` in your page templates - [ ] Test sidebar navigation highlighting - [ ] Test navbar dropdowns - [ ] Test responsive design on mobile  ## Performance Tips  1. **Cache fragments**: These components are lightweight and cached by Thymeleaf 2. **Async data loading**: Load unreadCount and notifications asynchronously if expensive 3. **Conditional rendering**: Use `th:if` to hide unused elements based on user role  ## Security Notes  - All links use `th:href="@{...}"` for proper URL encoding - Profile links require `@AuthenticationPrincipal` UserPrincipal - Logout uses POST form (CSRF protected by Spring Security) - All user data is properly escaped by Thymeleaf  ---  For more information, visit: - [Thymeleaf Layout Dialect](https://ultraq.github.io/thymeleaf-layout-dialect/) - [Thymeleaf Documentation](https://www.thymeleaf.org/doc/tutorials/3.0/usingthymeleaf.html) - [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/docs)

     nodes.creditMinInput.value = state.creditMin;       nodes.includeAllAcademyUsers.checked = state.includeAllAcademyUsers;     }      function fillSelect(select, values, currentValue) {
